answer: Work waits on the gale until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the mirror of the next round. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. By the island of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work.
